triage_records.title: Definitions and characteristics of sodium sensitivity and blood pressure resistance.
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper presents original empirical data from a study involving 198 subjects with essential hypertension. It explicitly measures blood pressure changes following sodium and volume depletion (induced by a low sodium diet and furosemide) and identifies a subset of hypertensive individuals who are 'sodium-sensitive' (showing a significant drop in blood pressure). This directly provides evidence on whether dietary sodium restriction lowers blood pressure in hypertensive individuals, although it highlights heterogeneity in response.
